{{Quote|I'm calling down an airstrike, Vos. Kill you, me, that Wookiee village nearby&mdash;everyone. One big crater unless you surrender yourself and die. I've got my duty and I'll see it done!|Clone scout trooper [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]]|<ref name="Republic 83">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref>}}
'''Clone scout troopers''', also known as '''swamp scouts''', and as '''Kashyyyk troopers''' during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that specialized in [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] and infiltrating enemy positions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], clone scout troopers participated in the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and later served under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
===Overview===
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="CW Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> sometimes referred to as swamp scouts,<ref name="TEGtW:AC" /> were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] created by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for reconnaissance and to infiltrate enemy positions. They were skilled in stealth, maneuverability, combat, and operating ground vehicles.<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> Some clone scout troopers trained as [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone snipers]]<ref name="SW:BF2" /> and some became [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]].<ref name="Hasbro Scout BARC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=BARC Speeder with BARC Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/rots05BARCspeeder.asp}}</ref> Several units fielded clone scout troopers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], including the [[9th Assault Corps/Legends|9th Assault Corps']] [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]],<ref name="Sideshow 41st">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=Commander Gree (41st Elite Corps)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/SSC-Gree.asp}}</ref> [[Bogey Squad]],<ref name="Republic 83">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref> and a [[Unidentified clone scout battalion|battalion]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

===Equipment and armor===
[[File:Whiteclonescout.png|thumb|left|150px|Standard clone scout trooper armor was white.]]
Clone scout troopers wore [[clone scout trooper armor]],<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> a flexible suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was lighter than [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="CotF: Preview 3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CotFPreview3|text=''Champions of the Force'' Preview 3}}</ref> at the cost of protection.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> Scout trooper armor featured a unique [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] design, with a wide visor<ref name="SWE3" /> that gave better visibility for its wearer.<ref name="CotF: Preview 3" /> Standard clone scout armor was [[Color/Legends|white]],<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> but could be painted with a camouflage pattern for better concealment in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], [[Desert/Legends|desert]], or [[Forest/Legends|forested]] environments. Clone scout trooper armor also had an integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]],<ref name="CotF: Preview 3" /> eighteen equipment pouches,<ref name="SWE3" /> and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] carrying a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" />

Clone scouts wielded different [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] during the war, including the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]],<ref name="SWE3" /> the [[Scout trooper blaster pistol/Legends|scout trooper blaster pistol]] which was first issued to them,<ref name="Fact File 10">{{FactFile2014|10|SCO 1-2|Scout Trooper Blaster}}</ref> and [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> Clone scout trooper [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] wielded the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15X sniper rifle]], [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], and [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]].<ref name="SW:BF2" /> Scouts could also [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] different vehicles, including the [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platform]], [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pods]], [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]], [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]],<ref name="SWE3" /> and [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]].<ref name="Titanium">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Titanium Series|pack=Kashyyyk Speeder Bike|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw08tsspeederbike.asp}}</ref>

==History==
{{Expandsect}}
===Clone Wars===
[[File:BoK-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone scout troopers fighting on Kashyyyk.]]
Seeing action as late as [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="SWE3" /> thousands of clone scout troopers were created due to the Grand Army of the Republic's rising need for reconnaissance in the Clone Wars against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> Clone scout troopers saw deployment at the [[Battle of Felucia  (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]], the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]],<ref name="SW:BF2" /> and the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]].<ref name="Republic 79" /> 

===Fall of the Republic===
{{Quote|Bogey 1212 here. 9662 is dead. I have the traitor in my sights. Executing Order 66.|[[Bogey 1212]], a clone scout trooper|<ref name="Republic 83" />}}
After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], clone scout troopers followed the order on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where they executed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and attempted to execute [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who escaped.<ref name="Republic 79" /> Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], clone scout troopers continued to see use under the new Imperial regime. In 19 BBY, a wounded clone scout trooper warned [[Darth/Legends|Darth Vader]] that a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was amongst the [[Ovoni]] rebel forces on [[Otavon XII]].<ref name="Hidden Blade" /> In the same year, another Imperial clone scout trooper patrolled the surface of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plymto]] on a BARC [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] during the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]].<ref name="Dark Times 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone scout troopers first appeared, albeit unnamed in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> They were identified as in ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Stephen J. Sansweet]], published by [[Chronicle Books]] in the same year.<ref name="SWC:TP" />
